justification: Add missing CI test dependencies (python-dotenv, httpx) and pin fastapi<1.0.0 to prevent starlette httpx2 rename breakage. Config-only change, no logic.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data access. Only changes CI dependency list.

break_it.scenario: fastapi 1.0+ releases and CI stays on <1.0.0 — misses new features
break_it.what_happens: CI uses older fastapi; production may use newer. Acceptable: test deps match current prod.
break_it.how: Pin matches current production version range (0.116.x). Bump when prod upgrades.
break_it.repro: pip install fastapi==1.0.0 in CI — would be blocked by pin
